preconditions.description: The number of provinces P must be between 1 and 15 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 600 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit() and int(line) == N)
preconditions.description: For each province, N must be between 1 and 600 inclusive, where N is the number of columns in the province.

preconditions.expression: all(len(S) == N for S in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit()])
preconditions.description: Each row string S in the province must have length exactly equal to N.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S) for S in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit()])
preconditions.description: Each character in the row strings must be a lowercase letter from 'a' to 'z'.

postconditions.description: For each province, the output must be the number of distinct strings formed by all possible minimal Hamiltonian paths in the 2xN grid, separated by newlines.
